name: XCC_ARCHIVE_PURGE_GT
description: This temporary table is used by the archive and purge process to copy budget entries and activities from the original table to the history table.

columns.name: HEADER_NUM
columns.description: Transaction that is archived and purged.

columns.name: LINE_NUM
columns.description: Line number that is archived and purged.

columns.name: BALANCE_LINE_ORDER
columns.description: Activity that is archived and purged. For budget data, the default value is -9.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Control budget that is archived and purged.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period that is archived and purged.

columns.name: BUDGET_CCID
columns.description: Budget account that is archived and purged.

columns.name: BUDGET_ACTION
columns.description: Indicates whether the distribution account row is for balance initialization or adjustment.

columns.name: MASTER_PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Period name of source control budget.
